kicker: Three agent harnesses, read at source

scenes.headline: Where three agent tools check the agent's work
scenes.sub: A game studio, a video skill and a Rust launcher
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pakora! Three new tools wrap a coding agent around one job. Let's see where each makes the agent check its work.

scenes.text: A harness is worth what its checks are worth: a compiler, a blind vote, a probe, or a picture the agent has to open.
scenes.say: The idea: a harness is worth what its checks are worth.

scenes.title: The game studio edits itself through a gate

steps.say: The game agent may rewrite its own skills and code, but every change lands first in a copy.
The copy is type checked, then booted.
Only a pass is written, between two snapshots. The judge's rubric stays frozen.

scenes.title: Skill edits must win a blind vote
scenes.say: Between runs, a second loop tunes the skills.

items.text: Mine tasks from the run log
items.say: It mines tasks from the run log.
It proposes at most four small edits.
A judge compares old and new on the hidden half, three times, sides swapped. Two wins, or it is refused.

steps.say: The launch video shows it as a one line diff.
The real playbook has no such section, so read it as an illustration.

scenes.title: The video skill: probe, plan, run, look

items.say: The video skill probes the file first.
A dry run prints the exact command.
One script runs. The model never writes a filter graph.
The code proves the output is media.
Then the agent must open a contact sheet, or admit it never looked.

left.title: Native fast path
left.say: The Rust launcher answers small commands without Node.

right.title: Anything agentic
items: a verbatim exec of the original
right.say: Anything agentic goes to the original harness, which boots Node as before.

scenes.label: faster at printing a version string, not at starting an agent
scenes.say: So the headline speedup measures printing a version string.

scenes.text: Machine checks are cheap and narrow. Judgement checks are soft. Good harnesses say which one passed.
scenes.say: Machine checks are cheap and narrow. Judgement checks are soft. Good harnesses say which one passed.

recap: Self edits pass a compiler and a boot

scenes.say: Self edits pass a compiler. Skill edits win a vote. And the agent has to look.
